title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays is a free open play night of American Mahjong at The Gallery at the Gillioz, hosted with Blooming Bams. Drop in or stay the whole time; it is for players of all skill levels who already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules), and you should bring your own 2026 NMJL card. It takes place Monday, December 7, 2026, 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO.

organizer.name: The Gallery at the Gillioz with Blooming Bams
